heard: Air pressure sealed three astronauts inside a burning cabin. Most people think the Apollo 1 crew died in space, but the disaster happened during a routine test on the ground. NASA considered it safe because the rocket was unfuelled. Inside, the cabin held pure oxygen at extremely high pressure. A single electrical arc turned the cockpit into a furnace. Rising pressure forced the inward opening hatch shut like a cork. This failure forced NASA to invent the outward swinging emergency hatch. Before that fix, air pressure sealed three astronauts inside.
